doc.name: Polska Szkoła AI
doc.instructions:
Polska Szkoła AI (PSAI) is a Polish AI training and consulting company based in Wrocław, working across Poland and online. It combines hands-on AI practice, change psychology and UX in AI trainings and AI rollouts for companies and public institutions.

The tools return PSAI's training catalogue, full training descriptions, company information and the free Kompas AI organisational AI-readiness test (questions and scoring). All content is in Polish.

Facts about the offer:
- PSAI does not publish prices. Quotes are prepared after a short conversation and depend on the programme scope, format (online or on-site) and number of groups.
- Trainings are closed (run for one organisation), online or on-site anywhere in Poland, on-site groups up to 12 people, 1 or 2 days. Dates, trainers and availability are agreed individually and are not available through this server.
- Dates and quotes are requested through the inquiry form on each training page (field "formularz") or at https://polskaszkola.ai/kontakt.html. This server does not collect personal data and cannot submit inquiries.

tools.name: about_psai
tools.title: O Polskiej Szkole AI
tools.description: Who Polska Szkoła AI is (Polish AI training and consulting company, Wrocław), how it works, how pricing works (no public price list), contact, offer overview, training categories and general FAQ. Content in Polish.

tools.name: list_trainings
tools.title: Lista szkoleń AI
tools.description: List PSAI's AI trainings for organisations in Poland (closed group trainings, online or on-site). Optional filters: category, format, number of days, free-text search (e.g. "marketing", "liderzy", "ChatGPT", "podstawy"). Returns slug, name, short description, audience, level, duration, formats, page URL and inquiry form URL. Categories: start = Na start; zespol = Zespoły i menedżerowie; marketing = Marketing; zmiana = Liderzy i zmiana; zaaw = Zaawansowani; trener = Trenerzy.

szukaj.description: Free-text search in name, description, audience and skills (Polish)

tools.name: get_training
tools.title: Szczegóły szkolenia
tools.description: Full description of one PSAI training: who it is for, outcomes, benefits, requirements, outline programme by module, methods, materials, format, how dates and pricing work, FAQ and the inquiry form URL. The training is identified by its slug, its name or its page URL. Content in Polish.

tools.name: kompas_questions
tools.title: Kompas AI: pytania
tools.description: The 24 questions of Kompas AI, PSAI's free organisational AI-readiness test, each with four answers (values 0-3), plus the question-set version. The full test takes about 7 minutes and is answered by someone who knows the organisation. Content in Polish.

tools.name: kompas_result
tools.title: Kompas AI: wynik
tools.description: Scores 24 Kompas AI answers (values 0-3, in question order) with the same method as polskaszkola.ai/kompas.html. Returns the organisation pattern (one of six), position on the people/system map, six area scores 0-100, the weakest area with its risk, the recommended first step and the link to the full e-mailed report. Nothing is stored except an anonymous call counter.
